Resample Data by EM Algorithm Clusters

Source: R/cluster_bootstrap.R
sample_clusters.Rd

Resample Data by EM Algorithm Clusters

Usage

sample_clusters(hawkes, parent_mat, boundary = NULL)

Arguments

hawkes

A hawkes object to resample.

parent_mat

Parent probabilities estimated with parent_est().

boundary

Optional boundary width used for edge correction.

Value

A resampled hawkes object.

Examples

params <- list(
  background_rate = list(intercept = -4.5, z = 1),
  triggering_rate = 0.5,
  spatial = list(mean = 0, sd = 0.75),
  temporal = list(rate = 2),
  fixed = list(spatial = "mean")
)
data("example_background_covariates")
hawkes <- rHawkes(
  params,
  c(0, 50),
  example_background_covariates,
  covariate_columns = "z",
  spatial_burnin = 1
)
est <- hawkes_mle(hawkes, inits = params, boundary = 1)
parent_mat <- parent_est(hawkes, est)
sample_clusters(hawkes, parent_mat, boundary = c(.5,3))
